insight: Has powered over 1 billion minutes of live AI translation for 6M users across 120 countries, with $200M+ saved versus human interpreters.
name: Wordly
tagline: Real-time AI translation and captions for meetings and events.
description: Wordly delivers real-time AI translation, live captions, transcripts, and summaries for meetings and events across dozens of languages — no special equipment or human interpreters required. It works with Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, Webex, and in-person events, and attendees join translated audio or captions from a browser or the mobile app.

modelSupport.notes: Proprietary real-time speech-translation and captioning pipeline across dozens of languages.

edge: Purpose-built for live events: one hourly rate bundles translation, captions, transcripts, and summaries across dozens of languages, no hardware.
pros: Real-time translation + captions for live events
